first_impression.reaction: Seminyak is on our list because friends have been, so I clicked. The intro is plain: five beachfront resorts, two places a few streets back, no 'paradise', no 'dream day'. That earns a skim. The guest-count grid is the part I'd use. But again no prices, no real wedding of yours, and a lot of 'Not published', so it feels like a careful spec sheet rather than someone who has actually done a wedding here.

journey.quote: Every venue here hosts weddings, and each is set out on the same terms so you can compare them fairly.
journey.reaction: Good. Same format for each, not a ranking. That's how I'd want to compare them with James.

journey.quote: None of the seven publishes exclusive use of the whole property, so ask in writing whether your ceremony and reception spaces can be closed to other guests.
journey.reaction: Honest, and exactly the thing I'd worry about: strangers in swimmers wandering past our vows. Useful to know up front.

journey.quote: Use this grid to narrow by numbers. Each figure is the venue's own, for the space named.
journey.reaction: Most useful bit. For 60 to 90 I can see Purnama Chapel at 90 and Hotel Indigo at 80. Tight but workable. Sending this to James.

journey.quote: 1 BELOW, a 50-square-metre room concealed behind cascading water, seats 16 with its own chef: a rehearsal dinner few guests will have seen before.
journey.reaction: That's a detail that makes it feel personal rather than a package. More of this, please.

journey.quote: Not published: a dedicated ceremony space.
journey.reaction: The biggest wedding operation on the list and nobody can tell me where the ceremony actually happens? Fair to flag, but frustrating.

journey.quote: The resort's wedding packages are offered for non-legal arrangements only.
journey.reaction: Glad this is spelled out. That's the kind of trap I'd hate to discover after paying a deposit.

journey.quote: Four venues each take up to 80 guests: Secret Garden Pool and Tree Bar, both with ocean and sunset views, SugarSand Sunset Terrace, and Kamaveda and Neighborhood Gallery.
journey.reaction: I count five names there, or is it four pairs? I had to read it twice.

journey.quote: A triple-tier dive tower into the pool, which your guests will find before you do.
journey.reaction: Funny line, but a pool-club party open to the public 10am to 9pm is the try-hard Bali our friends would roll their eyes at. Not for us, which is fine.

journey.section: Money and contracts: questions to ask each venue
journey.quote: Whose name is on the contract, and in what currency is it written and paid?
journey.reaction: Right question for our currency fear. But it's another list for us to chase, and there's still not one price on the page. Dad will ask what it costs before anything else.

journey.section: How do guests get to Seminyak?
journey.quote: How long is the journey from the airport at the time of day your guests land?
journey.reaction: That's literally my question about the grandparents, handed back to me. Seminyak is meant to be close to the airport; just give a rough time.

journey.section: How do guests get to Seminyak?
journey.quote: Volcanic activity can bring flight delays, cancellations or airport closures with little or no notice, so build a buffer day into the guest schedule.
journey.reaction: Practical. The buffer day is the sort of insider advice I want.

journey.section: When should you marry in Seminyak?
journey.quote: There have been cases of methanol poisoning in Bali, and as little as one shot can be fatal, so serve and order only branded alcohol.
journey.reaction: True and useful, but this hazards list would put Mum off Bali entirely. And the section called 'When should you marry' never actually says which months are best.

journey.section: Can foreigners legally get married in Bali?
journey.quote: If you want a symbolic ceremony on the beach, plan the legal marriage separately: Hotel Indigo's celebrant ceremony is non-legal, as are The Seminyak Beach Resort's packages.
journey.reaction: Clearer than I expected. James isn't religious, so I assume legal in Sydney and symbolic here, but I'd still like that said outright.

journey.section: Shortlist your Seminyak venues with a Wedded Advisor
journey.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, who works in your time zone and quotes in AUD for Australian couples.
journey.reaction: AUD, one person and fee in writing are what I want to hear. Still doesn't say who is standing on the beach in Seminyak on the day if something goes wrong.

unanswered_questions: Roughly what does a Seminyak wedding for 60 to 90 guests cost, even as a From AUD range?
How long is the transfer from the airport to Seminyak?
Which months are best for a beach ceremony with older guests?
If we don't share a recognised religion, is the usual path a legal marriage at home plus a symbolic ceremony in Bali?
Where does the ceremony actually happen at W Bali Seminyak?
Is Hotel Indigo's list four venues or five?
Can we bring our own stylist, photographer or florist to these resorts?
Do you have a real Seminyak wedding (venue, date) we can look at? (deferred business detail)
Who is on the ground in Seminyak on the day: your own person or a local partner? (deferred business detail)
Do you arrange guest airport transfers, including for grandparents? (deferred business detail)
How does Wedded Wonderland charge: flat fee, percentage, commissions? (deferred business detail)

turn_offs_found.quote: Anything this guide marks "Not published", from capacity to exclusive use, needs an answer in writing before you commit
turn_offs_found.why: Vague pricing with no ranges: a full venue guide with no cost figure at all feeds our hidden-costs and currency fear.

turn_offs_found.quote: Your Wedded Advisor is one person, start to finish, who works in your time zone and quotes in AUD for Australian couples.
turn_offs_found.why: 'Start to finish' is the generic end-to-end claim. It doesn't say who is accountable in Seminyak on the day or whether local work goes to strangers.

turn_offs_found.quote: For real weddings and settings to compare, browse the [free Wedded Wonderland magazines]
turn_offs_found.why: Points us elsewhere for real weddings instead of showing one here with venue and date, which is the trust signal we need before enquiring.

would_share_with: James: the 'Guest count by space' grid and the W Bali 1 BELOW note, because they narrow venues to our 60 to 90 guests and give us a rehearsal dinner idea
My parents: the 'Can foreigners legally get married in Bali?' section, because Dad will ask if it's legal at home. Not the hazards list for Mum yet

cta_reaction.quote: When you are ready, [shortlist your Seminyak venues through Wedded Concierge](https://weddedwonderland.com/wonderland-concierge?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=seminyak-wedding-venues&utm_content=closing).
cta_reaction.why: Calm and no hard sell, AUD and fee in writing are right. But no price range, no transfer time and no real Seminyak wedding of yours. I'd read another post and want to see a real wedding first.

top_3_changes: Give us a cost anchor: 'Whose name is on the contract, and in what currency is it written and paid?' is the right question, but add a From AUD range (with sign-off) or say plainly how we get venue pricing.
Answer the grandparents question: 'How long is the journey from the airport at the time of day your guests land?' hands it back to us. Give a rough airport-to-Seminyak transfer time.
Link a real Wedded Wonderland Seminyak or Bali wedding with venue and date, and fix the Hotel Indigo line 'Four venues each take up to 80 guests' so the count matches the names.

checks.check: Every journey point and turn-off has an exact quote from the draft
Journey types limited to gained_trust, lost_trust, confused, bored, excited, objection
Stayed in character as Sophie & James (planner couple): skimmed, looked for guest numbers, transfers, legal confidence, hidden costs and accountability
No invented brand facts; fees, on-the-ground team, real weddings and transfers listed as deferred unanswered questions
VERIFY markers and HTML comments (fact tags, image slots) ignored

open_questions.question: Hotel Indigo: 'Four venues each take up to 80 guests' lists what reads as five names. Is the count or the list wrong?
Is a From AUD range or an airport-to-Seminyak transfer time available from a source for this guide?

assumptions: Sophie & James arrived via a Google search for 'seminyak wedding venues' with Bali as one early option, so relevance is 4 and enquiry likelihood 2 (they enquire after 2 to 3 posts plus a real wedding).
Business details and fee amounts are deferred and not penalised as must-fix.
Fast-mode read: skimmed venue profiles, read the intro, tables, questions lists, transport, weather, legal and close; FAQ skimmed.
